  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY

output_text:
```python
from google.cloud import documentai_v1beta3 as documentai
import os

def extract_invoice_details(gcs_uri):
    project_id = "YOUR_PROJECT_ID"
    location = "us"
    processor_id = "YOUR_PROCESSOR_ID"  # Set to your Invoice Parser Processor ID

    client_options = {"api_endpoint": f"{location}-documentai.googleapis.com"}
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(client_options=client_options)

    # The full resource name of the processor
    name = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor_id}"

    # Read the file from GCS
    with open(gcs_uri, "rb") as image:
        image_content = image.read()

    # Set the mime_type to application/pdf
    mime_type = "application/pdf"

    # Set the raw document with the content and mime_type
    raw_document = documentai.RawDocument(content=image_content, mime_type=mime_type)

    # Set the request with the processor name and raw document
    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=name, raw_document=raw_document)

    # Process the document
    result = client.process_document(request=request)

    # Extract fields from the response
    document = result.document
    fields = document.fields

    vendor = fields["vendorName"].value_string
    date = fields["invoiceDate"].value_string
    total = fields["totalAmount"].value_string

    line_items = []
    for line_item in fields["lineItems"].array_value.elements:
        line_item_dict = {}
        for field in line_item.map_value.fields.items():
            line_item_dict[field[0]] = field[1].value_string
        line_items.append(line_item_dict)

    return {
        "vendor": vendor,
        "date": date,
        "total": total,
        "line_items": line_items
    }
```
